name: mcap-gripper-percam
description: MCAP gripper rig with one compressed topic per camera and /info/gripper_feedback_*
_comment: FREQUENTLY TUNED: the video block below; an explicit CLI flag always wins.
This is the layout to prefer when recording: each camera keeps its native
resolution and its own capture stamp, both of which the /quad_tile mosaic
destroys. Recordings in this generation have been seen without
/control/gripperValue* at all, so missing_topic_policy is fill -- the gripper
command is then reconstructed from its measured feedback.
notes: missing_topic_policy fill reconstructs an absent gripper command from the
measured feedback, which makes those action columns an identity copy of the
observation. Check audit.end_effector_action_source in the manifest: entries
reading state_fill teach the policy nothing about the gripper, so confirm the
gripper really was parked before training on such a batch.
Three cameras are required. Head-only recordings in this generation need their
own profile and therefore their own dataset.
